versions.summary: Scouts BSA patrol-method resident summer camp at Peaceful Valley (McNeil) Scout Ranch, Denver Area Council, in Elbert, Colorado, emphasizing patrol cooking and high-adventure outposts alongside merit badge programs.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored website is a reservation-level page covering three camps, so only features the council attributes to this camp by name were recorded.
